skills.name: Rallying Cry
skills.text:
Once per battle, this fighter can use the following bonus action:

**Rallying Cry [Bonus Action]:** This fighter heals 1 damage. In addition, at the end of the round, if this fighter is still on the battlefield, the commanding player does not need to take a Flee test for their warband.

skills.name: Point Blank Shot
skills.text: While this fighter is engaged in melee, they can attempt to make a Ranged Attack action. To do so, they take an Initiative test. If passed they can make a Ranged Attack action but cannot use a *Heavy* weapon. The Ranged Attack action must target a fighter they are engaged in melee with. If failed, the action immediately ends.

skills.name: Crackshot
skills.text: When making a ranged attack action, this fighter scores a critical hit on a natural roll of a 5 or a 6.

skills.name: Feint
skills.text: Once per melee attack action, after an enemy has successfully parried one of this fighter’s hits, this fighter can attempt a feint. To do so, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the parry roll, the hit is not parried and it becomes a critical hit.

skills.name: Explorer’s Instincts
skills.text: If this fighter is picked to lead a search party, you can re-roll one of the dice in the exploration roll (either the ‘tens’ or the ‘units’).

skills.name: Right On Time
skills.text: You can re-roll reinforcement rolls made for a battle group that includes this fighter.
